changes_vs_current: New topic. Scope: only things people do as a hobby. Watching TV/movies, listening to music, family/friends time, socializing, eating out, shopping, pets and internet use are left out, although they top the time-use and some poll lists (Harris 2013 TV 42%, CivicScience movies/TV 45%, ATUS TV 2.6h/day, YouGov listening to music 88%). They are passive pastimes or not hobbies, and the brief says to avoid 'watching TV' unless unavoidable. Excluded items were removed before each source's positions were counted. Merges: Cooking and Baking are separate items, and a merged poll category 'cooking/baking' gives both the same position. Painting and Drawing are separate, and Monmouth/Simmons/YPulse 'painting, sketching, drawing' or 'art' gives both the same position. Walking is merged into Hiking (alias 'walking'). Harris 2008/2013 name walking as a favorite, and YouGov has Walking, not Hiking. 'Outdoor activities' categories (Self/Statista, Statista CI, aytm, CivicScience, YPulse) go to Hiking and Camping, the examples aytm itself gives. Knitting and sewing are one item 'Knitting & Sewing', as YPulse 2019 groups them (sewing/knitting/crochet). Sports covers team and racket sports; Golf, Bowling, Swimming and Running stay separate because polls ask them separately. Computed order over 11 people sources (avg position, missing = source length + 5): 1 Reading 4.00, 2 Cooking 6.55, 3 Hiking 7.00, 4 Working Out 7.55, 5 Traveling 7.91, 6 Video Games 8.18, 7 Baking 8.36, 8 Gardening 8.64, 9 Camping 9.18, 10 Crafting 9.36, 11 Playing Music 10.18, 12 Photography 10.73, 13 Painting 11.00, 14 Sports 11.00, 15 Drawing 11.18, 16 Board Games 11.27, 17 Writing 12.27, 18 Swimming 12.82, 19 Bowling 13.91, 20 Fishing 13.91, 21 Golf 14.09, 22 Puzzles 14.09, 23 Sewing/Knitting 14.18, 24 Running 14.45; off the list: Collecting 14.73, Dancing 14.91, Yoga 15.27, Woodworking 15.45 (YouGov wood carving only), Hunting 15.55, Biking 15.64, Bird watching 16.18. Gut-check moves: (1) Fishing 20 -> 10. The only open-ended naming source that covers it, Harris 2008, ranks it 3rd among real hobbies (7%, tied with computer use, above golf, walking, gardening). The only lower source is YouGov liking (53%, rank 24, although fame is 98%). Most other sources never offered fishing as an option, so it was scored as missing there. That is why its average is low; no naming source puts it low. (2) Sports 14 -> 12: named #2 in both open-ended YPulse polls. YouGov liking (rank 19) is the only source that puts it lower. Kept at 12, below Crafting, because the all-ages Self survey puts sports & fitness (2.9%) well below arts & crafts. (3) Playing Music (13) and Photography (14) stay just below 12 after the two moves: Self, YouGov and Harris 2013 rank music below Gardening/Crafting, and Self and Monmouth rank photography below Camping and Crafting. (4) Painting stays 15. YouGov (16th), Monmouth (8th of 12, behind crafts/camping/photography) and Simmons (behind gardening) all place it below the items above it. Working Out (4) is not in the gut check but stays high: exercise is named in both Harris polls (#2 among real hobbies in 2008), both YPulse polls and aytm (41%). Camping (9) and Crafting (10-11) also stay by data. Video Games (gut #2) stays at 6 by data. Tail: Swimming, Bowling, Golf rest on Monmouth + YouGov (+ Harris 2008 for golf). Puzzles has one source (YouGov 73%) and is kept by the Solitaire Bliss tie-break (puzzling in its top 10). Running (Harris 2013, YPulse 2019, YouGov) takes 24 over Collecting (YouGov 55%, YPulse 2017 #15).
confidence: High for Reading at #1: it is first or second in every naming source and in Gallup's trend. Medium-high for the 2-12 set (Cooking, Hiking, Working Out, Traveling, Video Games, Baking, Gardening, Camping, Fishing, Crafting, Sports). Each has 2+ people sources, but their order within the set is soft, because most polls use broad categories (cooking/baking, outdoor activities, arts & crafts) that had to be split across items. Medium-low for 13-24: they rest on fewer sources, mostly YouGov liking and Monmouth's fixed list of 12. Doubts: no current YouGov/Talker hobby-naming poll was found. Both YPulse sources are ages 13-36 and lift Sports and Music. The Harris naming polls are from 2008/2013. Hiking includes YouGov 'Walking', which flatters it. Knitting & Sewing is a merged item, and Collecting, Woodworking, Dancing and Hunting just missed the 24.
